evidence_clip.semantics: absolute clip for centered log-support evidence

max_mean_invalid_mass.semantics: maximum mean task-invalid probability mass before abstention

max_mean_uncertainty.semantics: maximum population mean uncertainty before abstention

min_primary_margin.semantics: minimum mean-evidence gap before choosing primary label

protected_conflict_mean_gap.semantics: mean-evidence gap below which protected competitor causes UNCERTAIN

strong_evidence_threshold.semantics: threshold for protected minority candidate evidence
